My Video Folders & Saved Catalog

Your catalog is automatically saved to your computer so you can open LocalTube in any browser on your Mac or Windows PC without waiting for videos to reload.

✓ Automatic Catalog Discovery Across All Browsers Checking Default Location...

When you build your catalog in any browser (like Chrome), LocalTube saves it to your computer's default LocalTube folder (~/.localtube/) and inside your linked video folders. Opening LocalTube in Edge, Safari, Brave, or Firefox automatically loads that catalog.

Optional background helper so Edge, Chrome & Safari share ~/.localtube/ with zero folder prompts.
